notes.title: The Achievement Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40232488/6ca3ee44d527226bff45f94db3e64a063b0d6bf9.png[/img][h3]Added Achievements![/h3]
	- There are now 41 achievements, each with 6 unique levels for a total of 246 challenges to unlock and complete! You can also track your progess in the new Achievement Log
[h3]34 new shop items![/h3]
        - 6 modifiers, 6 die faces, 2 dice, and 20 passives!
[h3]Nine new custom/weekly mode modifiers![/h3]
        - Pick 1, Regression, Over and Over, Buyout, Jumping Dice, Bigger is Better, Point Eraser, One of a Kind, Cursed
[h3]New Quick Mode![/h3]
        - Quick mode now features randomized starting gifts for a more Roguelike feel
[h3]Balance, QoL, Bug Fixes and More![/h3]
- Reduced lag for many late-game builds
- Nerfed the ability for Add Die Discount, Circle of Life, Odd Adjacency Reroller, and Loyalty Card
- Buffed/Changed the ability for Healthcare Provider, 99 99's, Snake Eyes, Random Adjacency Reroller, and Faceup Die
- Face Swap and 2-5x Attached Multipliers are now available at tier 2
- Reincrementor is now available at tier 3
- 6x Reincrementor now available at tier 4
- Added title text to the Dice-o-pedia / Search menus
- Changed the end of game statistics (added stats for increments and infections)
- The refresh tooltip now disappears to not block shop items when refreshing multiple times
- Shop items now scale price differently based on their shop tier
- Passive abilities now scale price differently based on how many passives you already own
- You can no longer use shredders to get rid of diruses in the Infection game mode
- You can no longer use swap face to get 2 non-void faces in the Void game mode
- Various bug fixes and small QoL changes

notes.title: Roll 2.1
notes.content:
[u][b]8 new shop items![/b][/u]
[olist]
[*] Rain - Adds 1 to the number shown on all Numeric and blank faces.
[*] Snaking Multiplier - The snaking multiplier snakes between dice and eats all numeric die faces. Increases the value of the face it is pointing to based on its length and the total numeric value it has eaten. Disappears when it points to nothing or itself.
[*] Voidling - When this face is not rolled, it increases the value of whichever face is rolled by 50. Otherwise has no value.
[*] Lock Pick - When rolled, subtract 2 Lock Value from a random, adjacent, Locked Die. A Lock Pick can only be used once per Complete Roll.
[*] Lock Smith - When rolled, this face has a 2% chance to randomly lock one adjacent die. When a locked die becomes unlocked, if it is adjacent to a Lock Smith, it will create 2 copies of itself instead of 1.
[*] Cloverfield - Four Leaf Clovers are considered to be Viral Faces and have a chance, when rolled, to replace any other adjacent die face with a Four Leaf Clover.
[*] Diagonal Adjacency - Adjacent now includes diagonally adjacent dice.
[*] Circle of Life - When a die is reincremented, it generates a new blank die. All blank faces now spawn with a reincrementor attached to every face.
[/olist]
[list]
[*] Recently rolled passives are remembered and won't be given again in the shop
[*] If you hold the roll button for 75 straight rolls, you will start to 'Roll-out' and roll speed will increase!
[*] Custom Share: When you finish editing custom settings, a shareable code is copied to the clipboard. Paste a code from a previous game or from another player to automatically fill out custom settings!
[*] Two new custom/weekly mode modifiers: Survival and Passive Limit
[*] Mobile versions now display which upgrades are free/premium in the dice-o-pedia
[*] Airstrikes are "animated"
[*] Added the option to reset your own highscores
[*] Shortened description of all die faces and added Die Face, Attachment, and Modifier tags
[*] Non-Numeric Adjacency Multipliers no longer get friendly rerolls
[*] Doubler now starts at 64 but requires 4 rerolls to double
[/list]

notes.title: Roll 2.0
notes.content:
Thank you so much for being patient while I worked on this update. The game needed a lot of restructuring in its coding architecture to make it more sustainable in the future. This update brings so many changes and new content that I can't possibly remember everything that went into it but here's the biggest chages:
[list]
[*]90 new shop items!
[*]3 new game modes: Quick, Weekly, and Custom
[*]Now available on mobile devices!
[*]Dice-o-pedia to view all available items
[*]Post-game statistics
[*]Un-capped rerolls
[*]In-game search, inspect, and undo functions
[*]Fully Resizeable Display
[*]New tutorial
[/list]

notes.title: UX Overhaul
notes.content:
[h1]Roll: UX Overhaul[/h1]
[h3]New Features, QoL, And Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] Every item in the game was given a new description

[i]The aim of this update is to improve readability and clarity of all item descriptions. If you feel any of the descriptions are still confusing or have any typo, grammar, or suggestions regarding the descriptions let me know![/i]

[*] Some items were given a new name/title to better differentiate or describe them
[*] Descriptions can now be accompanied by subdescriptions to help reference other upgrades or game mechanics
[*] Descriptions of die faces can now be viewed from the Expanded Dice View
[*] A preview of the die face you are currently selecting is present in the Expanded Dice View
[*] You will now zoom in to the location of your cursor on the Expanded Dice View when scrolling
[*] Analytic mode will now show you the result of each die's Complete Roll (roll + rerolls).
[*] Analytic mode text has better readability, especially in night mode and on top of die faces
[*] With Analytic mode on you can hover over the Roll Counter (top right corner) to see stats for the entire roll
[*] Entire roll stats (hover top right) will show the total points accrued for each Complete Roll (roll + rerolls) as well as the best 3 performing dice from that roll. 
[*] When showing the Entire Roll stats, the 3 best performing dice will be shaded (can be accessed in the Expanded Dice View as well).
[*] Wilds should now properly target Lottery Total Roll Multipliers.
[*] Fixed Left/Right sums gaining excess value on rerolls
[*] Improved graphical quality of the title screen
[*] Improved images for 200/300 roll locks
[*] Left clicking an item you cannot afford will flag it
[/list]

[h3]Added Content[/h3]
[u][b]3 New Items[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Shop Weight: After purchasing a Shop Weight, the next item purchased from the shop, which is not a Passive Ability, will be more likely to appear in the shop's stock in the future. Can be applied to the same item multiple times.

[i]Shop weights should give you more control about which items are appearing in the shop. This will help you build more into the synergies you are going for.[/i]

[*] Cleanse Shop: Removes all Shop Weights everywhere. Any item affected by a Shop Weight that is currently in the shop will have its cost reduced to 1. Additionally, all future Shop Weights will be more effective. Every Shop Weight purchased makes this item more likely to appear. Can be purchased more than once.

[i]Basically incase you get carried away with too many shop weights and you need to change your build's direction. Can also improve your shop weights to be "heavier" and get you some cheap items.[/i]

[*] Random Consecutive Die: A die with ascending consecutive numeric faces starting from a random number. Example: 37, 38, 39, 40, 41, 42

[i]This should further facilitate your ability to build better and longer runs.[/i]
[/list]

[h3]Updated Content[/h3]
[u][b]Item Changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Passive Hunter: Now only provides 1 free shop refresh instead of 2.
[*] Mail-in Rebate: Multiplies the final accrued value by 100 instead of 10.
[*] Failed lottery reroll: Rerolls failed lottery faces 3 times instead of 2.
[*] Factor 18 Multiplier: Now Factor 50 multiplier, multiplies the result of all dice by 50/(total quantity of dice in play). 
[*] 50 Dice Bonuses: 500% & 800% -> 100% & 200%
[*] 100 Dice Bonuses: 1000% & 3000% -> 300% & 500%
[*] 1000 Dice Bonuses: 5000% & 10000% -> 1000% & 2500%
[*] All Quantities x5: Now All Quantities x2
[*] Previous Roll Multiplier: Now will always multiply the previous roll unless the previous roll was another Previous Roll Multiplier. Now cannot have its value increased by passive abilities.
[*] Lottery Total Roll Multiplier: 10% 1/4 -> 10% x1/12
[*] Lottery Total Roll Multiplier: 20% 1/4 -> 33% x1/36
[*] Key: A Locked Die can only benefit from a key effect once per Complete Roll (roll + all rerolls).
[*] Locks: 300 & 500 -> 200 & 300
[*] Ninety-Nine Ninety-Nines: Now applies before the roll is calculated

[i]This will allow it to be effective with Only-Numeric Multiplier Squared[/i].

[*]Stop Production: All Generators will no longer have their stated effect. instead, they will be worth:(total quantity of dice in play) * (number of rolls to produce) * (10) or (quantity of free shop refreshes)^3

[i]Now gives points every roll instead of on die/refresh creation[/i]

[*]Adjacency Reroll Die: Now every face is a 3x adjacency reroller.
[*]Lottery Die: Now has an equal random chance for each face to be any standard lottery face.
[*]Modified Die: Now every face has a x10 attached multiplier on it
[*]Quantity Die (previously Dice booster): Now has an equal random chance for each face to be any value of die quantity multiplier, while the 6th face is still a Standard Die Generator.
[*]Four Leaf Clover: Now boosts lottery odds on its own die when not rolled as well as all other dice when rolled. 
[*]Lucky 7's: 7's and 77's adjacent to a Four Leaf Clover are now multiplied by [u][b]77[/b][/u].
[/list]

[u][b]Cancelled Upgrades[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The following upgrades have been removed from the game: Doubles Reroll, Triples Reroll, Even Reroll, #/5 Reroll, <6 Dice increase, 99 Decrementor, 99 Half Decrementor
[/list]

[u][b]Shop Changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Changed the way droprates are calculated to allow for Shop Weight implementation
[*] Changed the droprates of all items
[*] Increased Shop and Passive Scaling

[i] I will continue to nudge the scaling values around until I can find the right balance.[/i]
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the new stuff :)
-Xrai

notes.title: The '100 Dice Bonus is Busted' Update
notes.content:
[h3][u][b]Removed 100 Dice Bonus from the game.[/b][/u][/h3]
The stacking 20%  bonus was WAY too powerful at large dice quantities. This upgrade made the entire game reliant on a single passive… This is something I’d like to move away from in general, so the 100 dice bonus has been split up into multiple smaller bonuses which can be stacked as your number of dice increases. 

[u][b]Added 6 new passives[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] 50 Dice bonus (500%)
[*] 50 Dice bonus(800%)
[*] 100 Dice bonus(1000%)
[*] 100 Dice bonus(3000%)
[*] 1000 Dice Bonus(5000%)
[*] 1000 Dice Bonus(10000%)
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

[h3]The Leaderboard has been reset.[/h3]
Due to the massive impact 100 Dice Bonus had on scores, local highscores as well as the Top 100 and global rankings have been reset.

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where No Weights passives were triggering with weighted faces
[*] Fixed an issue where Wilds were not properly copying other faces
[*] Fixed an issue where players could roll while viewing the shop
[*] Fixed an issue which would softlock the game and stop decrementing the roll counter (i think)
[*] Fixed an issue where players could purchase 12 bogos
[*] Fixed add previous roll to rerolls and add die quantity passives not occuring before other passives
[/list]

[h3]Upgrade Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] < 6 dice reroll (x3)
[*] <6 dice increase(x3)
[*] <13 reroll(x2)
[*] Die rebate 1000 (used to be 500)
[*] Numeric bonus x50 (used to be x5, now tier 4)
[*] Adjacency multiplier x10 (used to be x1, now tier 3)
[*] Made locks less common 
[*] Passives Moved to Tier 4: Top 2, No 99’s Reroll, No Weights Increase, Add Die Quantity, Single Set Bonuses, Add Previous Roll to Rerolls, Rigged Machine
[*] Passives Moved to Tier 3: Die Quantity Single Face Multiplier, Numeric Bonus x10, Lucky Rerolls, Lucky 7’s, No Weight 200% Bonus, Perfect Square 200% Bonus, Weight Bonuses
[/list]


[h3]Sweeping Shop Price Changes[/h3]
I made shop price changes across the board, specifically trying to balance around the scaling ability of each upgrade and focusing more on the stage of the game in which the upgrade is available. (note these changes are to the base price of upgrades and do not affect the overall price scaling)

[i]EXAMPLE: The balance between Single Face Multiplier and Adjacency Multiplier is a good example of this. At face value, a x5 Single Face Multiplier is ~4x weaker than a x5 Adjacency Multiplier. The prices of each upgrade were ROUGHLY balanced around this idea (theres obviously a lot more that goes into it). However, when you consider the multiple passive abilities which apply to Single Face Multipliers allowing them to outscale Adjacency Multipliers, the same evaluation does not hold up. Furthermore, Adjacency Multipliers are available later in the game, making them even less valuable. This line of thinking (along with in-game experiences to back it up) has led me to reduce the cost of Adjacency Multipliers significantly and is exactly the kind of change which I am attempting to replicate across all upgrades. [/i]

Keep in mind that these price changes will more heavily influence the early/mid game, whereas the relative cost of upgrades becomes somewhat negligible as shop prices scale later in the game (more adaptive scaling to be potentially addressed in a future update). That being said, I made changes to the price of nearly every upgrade in the game (90% of upgrades?). I won’t be able to list all the changes here, but I will note some of the changes which I feel are most significant, and I highly encourage you to re-evaluate upgrades based on the price at which you see them in-game.  

[u]Some Notable Price Increases:[/u]
[list]
[*] ¼ Lottery Multipliers
[*] Previous Roll Multipliers
[*] Top 3
[*] No weight rr
[*] Add die quantity
[*] Single Set Bonus
[*] Rigged Machine
[*] Passive Hunter
[*] All Quantities x5
[/list]

[u]Some Notable Price Reductions:[/u]
[list]
[*] Incrementors
[*] Rerollers
[*] Adjacency Rerollers
[*] Adjacency Multipliers
[*] Four Leaf Clovers
[*] Lucky 7’s
[*] Square Bonus
[*] Square Increase
[*] Square Reroll
[*] Weight bonus
[*] Scavenger
[*] Immune Total Mults and Adders
[/list]

I am trying to keep the game at a fun, competitive, and playable state while also working on some BIG projects that will really bring Roll to the next level. I appreciate the patience and support from everyone as this game continues to develop. I might not be as responsive/engaged as usual for the next month or so while I work diligently on some big updates and spend time with family. 
Enjoy your holidays, much love,
Xrai

notes.title: The Viral Update
notes.content:
[h1]Roll: Viral Update[/h1]
[h3]Added Content[/h3]
[u][b]5 New Die Faces[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] 99 Die Adder: Replaces a die face of your choice with a 99 die adder. Every 100 times this face is rolled, it adds a new die with faces (99, 99, 99, 99, 99, 99)
[*] Left Sum: Replaces a die face of your choice with a left sum face. When rolled, this face will have the value of: The sum of each face to the left of this die until reaching the end of the row, or another left/right sum face. If pointing at a right sum face, all dice between the two will be multiplied by double the quantity of dice between them. This effect ignores wilds and faces which multiply the entire roll and this face cannot have its value increased by passive abilities.
[*] Right Sum: Replaces a die face of your choice with a right sum face. When rolled, this face will have the value of: The sum of each face to the right of this die until reaching the end of the row, or another left/right sum face. If pointing at a left sum face, all dice between the two will be multiplied by double the quantity of dice between them. This effect ignores wilds and faces which multiply the entire roll and this face cannot have its value increased by passive abilities.
[*] Exclusive Multiplier: Replaces a die face of your choice with an exclusive multiplier. When across all rolled dice, only 1 exclusive multiplier is rolled, the single exclusive multiplier will have the value of: all wilds and total roll multipliers (left/right sum, total roll lottos, multipliers) + 200% for each other exclusive multiplier in play that was not rolled. Each die can only hold one exclusive multiplier and when more than one of these faces are rolled, it will have no value. Cannot have its value increased by passive abilities.
[*] Dirus: Replaces a die face of your choice with a Dirus. When rolled, this face will have the value of: total dice quantity. This face also has a chance, when rolled, to replace an adjacent, numeric die face with a Dirus. If, across all rolled dice, there are zero numeric faces, Diruses will be worth 10x more.
[/list]
[u][b]11 New Passive Abilities[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Run Length Multiplier: When you roll a run (3 or more consecutive numbers), the value of all dice in the run will be multiplied by the length of the run.
[*] Mail-In Rebate: When a die gains a rebate, it will not pay out immediately. Instead, it will accrue all rebates over the next 100 rolls. After 100 rolls, the total amount accrued will be multiplied by 10 and paid out.
[*] Only Face Multiplier Squared: If the most common number rolled is also the only number rolled, the result of all multi-face multipliers will be multiplied by the number of occurrences an additional time.
[*] Viral Die Quantity Multipliers: Die quantity multipliers have a chance, when rolled, to replace any adjacent die face with a copy of itself. Additionally, Diruses will be 2x as likely to spread and the value of all Diruses will be multiplied by 10.
[*] Immune 99’s: Upon purchase, numeric 99’s are immune to the effects of Diruses and viral die quantity multipliers
[*] Immune Total Mults and Adders: Upon purchase, total roll multipliers (wilds, left/right sum, total roll lottos, multipliers) and all die/refresh adders are immune to the effects of viral die quantity multipliers.
[*] All Quantites x5: All die faces/passive abilities that gain value based on the total quantity of dice, will instead use 5x that amount.
[*] 100 Dice Bonus: For every 100 dice you roll, gain a stacking 20% bonus on all dice. Does not apply to wilds or faces that multiply the entire roll.
[*]Stop Production: All die/refresh adders will no longer add dice/shop refreshes. When they would normally add a die/refresh, they will instead be worth: Quantity of dice * number of rolls to produce * 100   or   Quantity of shop refreshes ^2 *100
[*] Ninety-Nine Ninety-Nines: If you roll 99 or more 99’s, all other rolled numeric faces will have their face value increased to 99.
[*] Add Die Discount: All Dice and Die Adder Faces are 15% Cheaper. Additionally, for each new die you gain, reduce current shop prices by 2%. Does not apply to refresh stock or shop upgrade. (Must refresh stock for 15% discount to apply).
[/list]
[h3]Updated Content[/h3]
[u][b]Upgrade Changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] All-In!: The result of all lottery faces will be multiplied by 10. [u][i]When all lottery faces in a roll are a failure, lose all banked points.[/i][/u]
[*] Set All Die Faces: Choose a numeric die face. All other faces on the chosen die will be set to the value of the chosen face. [u][i]Removes all incrementors.[/i][/u]
[*] Add [strike]half[/strike] die quantity: all numeric dice have [strike]half[/strike] the quantity of dice added to their roll result. This effect occurs before bonuses and after multipliers.
[/list]
[u][b]Cancelled Upgrades[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The following upgrades have been removed from the game: Doubles Increase, Triples Increase, Even Increase, #/5 Increase, #/5 Major Increase, Run Mega Increase, Die with random faces <13, Lotto Die Adder
[/list]
[u][b]Shop Changes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added 2 additional starting free shop refreshes (you now start with 3 free refreshes)
[*] All passives are 15% more expensive to start and now scale slightly faster than other upgrades
[*] Costs more to upgrade to higher shop tiers (excluding shop 1, very minor increase for shop 2)
[*] Slight increase to cost of die quantity multipliers
[*] Add reroll x1/2 and Add half incrementor are now available in the starting shop tier
[*] Cost reduction to add reroll x1/2/3 and half/full incrementor
[*] Cost reduction to basic numeric faces
[*] 99’s are more common amongst basic numeric faces
[*] Slight cost reduction to all dice and die adders
[*] Keys are slightly more common
[*] Adjacency multipliers are cheaper and available in earlier shop tiers
[*] High value (x5/10) single face multipliers are available in earlier shop tiers
[/list]

[h3]New Features, QoL, And Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a discord button with a link to the roll community discord.
[*] SUBSTANTIAL performance improvements for all performance modes, especially maximum performance.
[*] 99^2 or (9801) is now the maximum number of dice you can obtain. Any dice added via the shop or adders after this point will still contribute to Die quantity multiplier, Dirus, 100 Dice Bonus, Stop Production, and Add Die Quantity values, but will not be rolled and will have no value.
[*] You can now click and hold to roll.
[*] You can now navigate between views using the arrow keys.
[*] All fading transitions are now controlled by the transition speed setting.
[*] Different ‘switch view’ sound effects for each of the different transition speed settings that will more accurately match the speed of the transition.
[*] Added a popup that will notify players to turn off analytic mode for lag reduction.
[*] Fixed an issue where multiple users would share the same highscore.
[*] Fixed screen overlay issues between the shop and dice at large dice quantities.
[*] Fixed an issue where the shop indicatore button would disappear at the start of the game.
[/list]

I think that’s all the changes… honestly so much has changed that it’s hard to keep track at this point. Anyway, hope you enjoy the new stuff :)
-Xrai

notes.title: Bye Bye Score Limit!
notes.content:
[h3]Please continue using the forums to report bugs :) You all have been a huge help!
The following changes and fixes are addressed in this update:[/h3]

[list]
[*]The score limit has been removed. Scientific notation will be used for large numbers to allow for much higher scores
[*]4 new passive abilities: All-in, Bogo, Scavenger, PassiveHunter
[olist]
[*]All-in: Lottery Faces are multiplied by 7, Numeric faces are worth 0
[*]Bogo: Buy an upgrade get a random cheaper upgrade free! Can be purchased multiple times. Gives an additional free upgrade for each time you purchase this.
[*]Scavenger: Get a free shop refresh every 33 rolls instead of 100
[*]Passive Hunter: Get two free shop refreshes everytime you buy a passive abillity
[/olist]
[*]Boost to base game performance as well as variable performance modes now available in settings

[*]Buying an upgrade without applying it now results in a refund

[*]Shop price scaling reduced!

notes.title: Hold to roll is back! 4 New Upgrades! Bigger Shop!
notes.content:
Hold any key to rapidly roll!
The shop can now hold up to 12 upgrades at a time!
4 New Upgrades
  - Lottery-Multiplier: has a percent chance to be worth 1/4 the total roll (can be affected by lottery passives)
  - Rigged Machine: after a succesful lottery roll, the next lottery face on the same die will be a guaranteed success

notes.title: Cheaper Refresh and Passive Display! Leaderboard Reset!
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added a display for all active passives
[*]Decreased the rate at which all shop prices scale
[*]Drastically decreased the rate at which shop refresh prices scale
[*]Made the shop refresh adder cheaper and more common

notes.title: Balance Changes and bug fixes for the Content Update
notes.content:
[h2]Changes are accompanied by a highscore/leaderboard reset[/h2]
[u]BE AWARE[/u]... With all the new upgrades, scores are highly volatile and thus the leaderboard may be reset more frequently until the game finds a balanced state.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[h3]Some of the new upgrades were WAYYY stronger than their price tags warranted... I have Increased prices for many of the new upgrades to help balance the game.[/h3]
-Major increase in price for all die adder faces
-Increase in price for all dice upgrades (3rd row first 2 slots in the shop)
-Major increase in price for adding 2,5,10 dice 
-Increased scaling for die quantity multipliers (x100 more expensive, x10 about the same)
-[b]Increased scaling for all shop prices[/b] as the game progresses (scales proportional to n*log(n) instead of n where n is total points accrued over the course of the game.. ex. Prices after gaining about 1,000,000 points will be about 2x as much as the previous scaling, Prices after 1,000,000,000 about 4x, base prices are the same)
-Increased the price of all passive upgrades, 3-5k increase for most (3rd row last slot) 
-Nerfed the Big $pender passive, now provides 80% discount and x5 to dice rolls
-Bonuses will no longer apply to wilds/total roll multipliers... updated descriptions on all passives to reflect this change
-Previous roll multipliers will no longer apply to wilds/total roll multipliers... updated description
-Slight price reduction to previous roll multipliers to account for the change
-Major increase to price of wilds
-Major increase to price of wild adjacency multiplier

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
-Fixed an issue with 99decrementor faces making a blank die face
-Fixed an issue where wilds could target other wilds
-Fixed text description for Glue
-Significantly Increased Maximum Number of Die Slots
-Finally fixed the bug where an added modifier would not appear on the 'roll' screen until after the die had been rolled
-Fixed Shop prices overlapping in the shop

notes.title: Major Content Update
notes.content:
[h1]Here's a Complete List of All 68 New Upgrades[/h1]
[h2]New Die Add-ons:[/h2]
[h3]These Upgrades Appear in the First Row of the Shop[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Add Reroll 2 – Rerolls the attached die 2x when rolled
[*] Add Reroll 3 – Rerolls the attached die 3x when rolled
[*] Add Reroll x6 – Adds an attached reroll to all 6 faces on a die
[*] Add Reroll 2 x6 – Adds an attached reroll2 to all 6 faces on a die
[*] Add Reroll 3 x6 – Adds an attached reroll3 to all 6 faces on a die
[*] Add Glue – When rolled during a reroll, all following rerolls will roll the attached face
[*] Set All Die Faces – Choose one of your existing numeric faces, set all 6 faces on the die to that number
[*] Die Swap – Swap the positions of 2 dice
[*] Face Swap – Swap any 2 faces, even between dice
[/olist]
[h2]New Die Faces:[/h2]
[h3]These Upgrades Appear in the Second Row of the Shop[/h3]
[olist]
[*] 1% Lottery – 1% chance to be worth 77,777
[*] 5% Lottery – 5% chance to be worth 2,500
[*] 10% Lottery – 10% chance to be worth 1,000
[*] 50% Lottery – 50% chance to be worth 100
[*] Four Leaf Clover – When rolled, makes all lottery faces more likely to be successful
[*] Die Breeder Adder – Adds a die breeder every 200 rolls
[*] Dice Booster Adder – Adds a dice booster every 150 rolls
[*] Lottery Die Adder – Adds a die with lottery faces and four leaf clovers
[*] Shop Refresh Adder – Adds a free shop refresh every 50 rolls
[*] Adjacency Multipliers 1,2,5 – Equal to the value of adjacent numeric faces, times the multiplier value
[*] Die Quantity Multipliers 30,40,50,100 – Equal to the quantity of dice times the multiplier value
[*] Previous Result Multiplier 2,5,10 – Equal to the previous roll result of this die times the multiplier value
[*] Void – When this face is not rolled, multiply the rolled result by 2, removes weights, cannot be weighted
[/olist]
[h2]New Dice:[/h2]
[h3]These Upgrades Appear in the First Two Slots in the Last Row of the Shop[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Add 2 Dice – add 2 dice of all 1’s
[*] Add 5 Dice – add 5 dice of all 1’s
[*] Add 10 Dice – add 10 dice of all 1’s
[*] Add Die 77 – add a die of all 77’s
[*] Add Die 94up – add a die with faces 94, 95, 96, 97, 98, 99
[*] Add Die Breeder – add a die with 6 die adder faces
[*] Add Lottery Die – add a die with faces 50%, 50%, 10%, 5%, four leaf clover, four leaf clover. Has a 1% chance to add a 1% lottery face.
[*] Add Modified Die – add a die of all ones with reroll3’s attached to every face, 5x face multipliers on 4 faces, and two weighted faces with x10 face multipliers
[*] Add Prime Die – add a die of random prime numbers
[*] Add Reroller Die – add a die of adjacency rerollers 1,1,2,2,3,3
[*] Add Single Face Multiplier Die – add a die of single face multipliers with random values
[*] Add Void Die –add a die with 5 void faces and 1 numeric <99 face
[/olist]
[h2]New Passives: [/h2]
[h3]These Upgrades Appear in the Last Slot in the Last Row of the Shop[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Single Set Bonus 300% - if you only roll a single Yahtzee/triple/double gain the bonus
[*] Single Set Bonus 500% - if you only roll a single Yahtzee/triple/double gain the bonus
[*] Top 3 – Top 3 highest scoring dice are multiplied by 10, all other dice are multiplied by 1/2
[*] Factor 18 Multiplier – Multiplies the value of all dice by 18/quantity of dice
[*] Add Previous to Reroll – When rerolling, add the numeric value of the previous roll to the current roll, only adds consecutive numeric values
[*] Add Half Die Quantity – add quantity of dice/2 to all numeric faces before bonuses are applied
[*] Attached Multiplier Stack – attached multipliers now stack with single face, multi face, and adjacency multipliers
[*] Adjacent Wild Multiplier – when you roll a wild, if it is adjacent to the die it is copying, it is worth x10
[*] Adjacent Single Face Multiplier – when you roll a single face multiplier, if it is adjacent to the die it is targeting, it is worth x10
[*] Double Face Multiplier – single face multipliers now target the 2 highest numbers
[*] Highest Die Doubled – your highest scoring die is always doubled
[*] Additive Attached Multipliers – attached face multipliers no longer replace each other, they add instead up to x99
[*] ‘Heavy’ Weight Bonus 50% - a face rolled with a weight on it gains the bonus 
[*] ‘Heavy’ Weight Bonus 100% - a face rolled with a weight on it gains the bonus
[*] Light Weight Bonus 300% - a face rolled with a light weight on it gains the bonus
[*] Light Weight Bonus 500% - a face rolled with a light weight on it gains the bonus
[*] Lottery Bonus 500% - lottery faces gain the bonus
[*] Lottery Bonus 800% - lottery faces gain the bonus
[*] Slot Machine –when a lottery face is surrounded by other lottery faces, it is worth x10, you can also attach face multipliers to any lottery face
[*] Failed Lottery Reroll – when a lottery face is unsuccessful, it will reroll 2x
[*] Lottery Reroll Chance – when a lottery face is rerolled it is 2x as likely to be successful
[*] Lucky 7’s – when a lottery face is adjacent to a numeric 7 or 77, it is 2x as likely to be successful. Four leaf clovers adjacent to a 7 or a 77 are worth 777 points
[*] No 99’s Bonus 100% - if you don’t roll any 99’s gain the bonus
[*] No 99’s Bonus 200% - if you don’t roll any 99’s gain the bonus
[*] No 99’s Reroll 2x - if you don’t roll any 99’s reroll all dice 2x
[*] No Weights Bonus 100% - if you don’t roll any weights gain the bonus
[*] No Weights Bonus 200% - if you don’t roll any weights gain the bonus
[*] No Weights Increase 3x – if you don’t roll any weights increase numeric values by x3
[*] No Weights Reroll 3x – if you don’t roll any weights reroll all dice x3
[*] Perfect Square Bonus 100% - if you have a square number of dice (4,9,16,25…) gain the bonus
[*] Perfect Square Bonus 200% - if you have a square number of dice (4,9,16,25…) gain the bonus
[*] Perfect Square Increase 2x – if you have a square number of dice increase numeric values by x2
[*] Perfect Square Reroll 2x – if you have a square number of dice (4,9,16,25…) reroll all dice x2
[*] Big $pender – Cancels all current passive effects. Can no longer buy any passives. Shop prices are reduced by 85%. All roll results are multiplied by x15
[/olist]

[h1]There Were Also Some Major QoL Improvements and Gameplay Adjustments[/h1]
[h2]QoL[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Any Letter Key / Click to Roll – Roll MUCH faster by mashing on your entire keyboard like a crazy hacker person. Also you can Click or use spacebar to roll.
[*] Temporary “Night Mode” – Toggleable grey background in the options menu (options only accessible through ‘esc’ key and menu now. A more robust night mode is in the works, but this will help those with light sensitive eyes for now. 
[*] Blocking ineffective upgrades – If an upgrade does not affect the targeted face it will not be able to be applied to that face.
[*] More Specific Tooltips – I made a concerted effort to be more specific with upgrade tooltips
[/olist]
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Rebalanced Existing Upgrades –
[*]  First tier shop upgrades now range +1 to +5 and are much cheaper to make the early game faster. Also moved +6 to +10 down to second tier upgrades.
[*] Price adjustments for nearly all existing upgrades, significant increase to total roll multipliers and most bonus passives. Significant decrease to die quantity multipliers and numeric faces.
[*] Buffed the effect of Run Increase, Run Reroll, Few Dice Increase, Few Dice Reroll
[*] Nerfed the effect of Yahtzee bonuses, now 1000% and 500%
[*] No repeated passives – Once you buy a passive it will never show up in the shop again
[/olist]
[h2]Backend / Bug Fixes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Max Score Increase – Leaderboard now has the ability to hold scores up to 217Quadrillion… hopefully this will be enough to contain you!
[*] Fixed Leaderboard Entries – Score text will no longer overlap with name text in the leaderboard
[*] Fixed Offline Save System – Offline Scores were not working, but can now be submitted to the leaderboard once you connect online
[*] Improved Score Encryption – Improved data encryption to prevent score tampering
[*] New upgrade probability system – New system which gives me finer control of the likelihood of specific upgrades appearing in the shop
[*] Fixed save game bug – Fixed a bug where continuing a game would allow multipliers to change their value, but keep the same cost
[*] Fixed numeric multiplier – Numeric multiplier 5,10 says all non-numerics will have no effect, but instead just gave them no value… Now, they will have no effect
[*] Slight Reduction to image file size -  Images further compressed to account for all the new assets
[/olist]

notes.title: More QoL Changes!!!! Leaderboard Reset Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[h1]Another batch of QoL changes to help the game feel more relaxing and easier to understand/play![/h1]
[list]

[*][u][b]You can now ‘flag’ your next upgrade in the shop by right clicking on it. When you have enough points to purchase it, you will be automatically returned to the shop![/b][/u]
[i]No more rolling past upgrades or bouncing back and forth between the shop and the game, trying to remember the cost of the cost of the upgrade... "Was it 2500 or 2600???"[/i]

[*][u][b]Analytic mode! Turn on analytic mode in the options menu and hover over a die with your mouse to get a readout of its last roll result![/b][/u]
[i]There was a lot of frustration and confusion associated with upgrade descriptions and effects. It was also nearly impossible to tell how well a given die/setup was performing... With analytic mode you can see exactly what is happening behind the scenes and get a better grasp of the upgrades [/i]

[*][u][b]Performance Mode! If your computer struggles during the later stages of the game, turn on 
Performance mode in the options menu to reduce lag![/b][/u]
[i]Nothing is more frustrating than having 500 rolls left, you're ready to roll out, but your computer can only handle a couple of rolls at a time. Although sacrificing some of the satisfying sounds and effects, if you struggle with lag, nothing will be more satisfying than sprinting through the game at full speed! [/i]

[*][u][b]You can now navigate to/from the shop by presing tab/enter![/b][/u]
[i]That's it... thats the patch note[/i]

[*][u][b]Added comma separators for all cost/score fields[/b][/u]
[i]"Is that million or billion???"[/i]

[*][u][b]Fixed a heap of bugs, Thanks to everyone who is submitting on the Bug Spotting forum and to those emailing me their findings![/b][/u]

[i]Fixed an issue loading shop prices from a previous game, fixed an issue loading locks from previous games, fixed an issue when rerolling a single wild face, and more small fixes![/i]
[/list]

[h3]There will be a leaderboard reset coming sometime in the near future along with some balance changes and new upgrades! Thanks for all the support! If you want to to help me out, please leave a steam review and share with your friends![/h3]

notes.title: Save System!
notes.content:
Roll now offers a save system! I don't know why I didn't put this in the original build, but it's here now! You can now save your progress between play sessions. Just hit O/P/ESC from the game screen to bring up the options menu. Then hit the 'house' icon to take you back to the main menu, doing so will save your game. Upon starting the game again you will be prompted to start a new game or continue where you left off. The game will also save periodically in the background. 

I have also added a short instruction text which will appear on first boot of the game to help new players.

The main menu had an issue where the letters would glitch into position on boot, this animation has been smoothed out

Happy Rolling!
